# Google Domains
> Domain registration and DNS management service from Google, with support resources for domains, email, and website setup.

Google Domains helps users search for, register, transfer, and manage domain names, configure DNS, and connect domains to websites, email, and third-party services.

## Main Product
- [Google Domains](https://domains.google/): Main product homepage for searching, registering, and managing domain names.
- [My Domains](https://domains.google.com/registrar/): Account area for managing registered domains and DNS settings.
- [Domain Search](https://domains.google.com/registrar/search): Search interface for checking domain availability and pricing.
- [Transfer a Domain](https://domains.google.com/registrar/transfer): Start transferring an existing domain into Google Domains.
- [Google Domains Help](https://support.google.com/domains): Official help center for setup, management, billing, and troubleshooting.

## Getting Started
- [Register a Domain](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4490053): Steps for searching, purchasing, and registering a new domain.
- [Transfer Your Domain](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3251178): Instructions for moving a domain from another registrar.
- [Sign In to Google Domains](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3266402): Help for accessing your account and domain management tools.
- [Verify Contact Information](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4580697): Guidance on maintaining required registrant contact details.
- [Renew a Domain](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3263919): Information about manual and automatic domain renewal options.

## DNS and Domain Management
- [Manage DNS Records](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3290350): Add, edit, and remove DNS resource records for your domain.
- [Use Custom Name Servers](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3290309): Delegate DNS hosting to external name server providers.
- [Dynamic DNS](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6147083): Configure dynamic DNS for hosts with changing IP addresses.
- [DNSSEC](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6387342): Enable DNSSEC to help protect your domain from spoofing.
- [Forward Your Domain](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4522141): Set up web forwarding from your domain to another URL.
- [Forward Email](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3251241): Create email aliases that forward messages to existing inboxes.

## Email and Google Workspace
- [Set Up Google Workspace](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6068857): Connect your domain to Google Workspace for custom email.
- [Create Custom Email with Google Workspace](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6068858): Use your domain for professional Gmail addresses.
- [Set Up MX Records](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3290350): Configure mail routing records for email providers.
- [Email Forwarding](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3251241): Route mail sent to your domain to another email address.
- [Troubleshoot Email Issues](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3251241): Resolve common forwarding and mail delivery configuration problems.

## Website Connection and Hosting
- [Connect to a Website Builder](https://support.google.com/domains): Help articles for connecting domains to website platforms.
- [Use Web Forwarding](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4522141): Point visitors to another site without changing hosting.
- [Connect to Google Sites](https://support.google.com/domains): Guidance for using your domain with Google services and hosted sites.
- [Connect to Shopify, Squarespace, or Wix](https://support.google.com/domains): Support resources for third-party website integrations.
- [Set Up Synthetic Records](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3290350): Use forwarding and subdomain records for common hosting scenarios.

## Billing and Account
- [Payment and Billing Help](https://support.google.com/domains): Help center resources for charges, renewals, and invoices.
- [Turn Auto-Renew On or Off](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3263919): Manage automatic renewal settings for your domains.
- [Update Contact Information](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4580697): Change registrant, admin, or technical contact details.
- [Manage Domain Sharing](https://support.google.com/domains): Control access for other users on your domains.
- [Refunds and Cancellations](https://support.google.com/domains): Find policies and support information for billing changes.

## Security and Privacy
- [Privacy Protection](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3251242): Learn about WHOIS privacy availability and contact data handling.
- [Two-Step Verification for Google Account](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185839): Secure the Google account used to manage domains.
- [DNSSEC Setup](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/6387342): Protect DNS responses with signed zone data.
- [ICANN Contact Verification](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/4580697): Meet domain registration verification requirements.
- [Google Privacy Policy](https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/): Privacy terms governing use of Google services.
- [Google Terms of Service](https://www.google.com/policies/terms/): Terms applicable to Google products and services.

## Support and Policies
- [Google Domains Help Center](https://support.google.com/domains): Central support hub for all Google Domains topics.
- [Community Support](https://support.google.com/domains/community): Community discussions and peer help for domain issues.
- [About Google](https://www.google.com/about/?utm_source=domains.google&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=domains-footer-en): Corporate information about Google and its products.
- [Google](https://www.google.com/): Main Google homepage.
- [Privacy](https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/): Official Google privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://www.google.com/policies/terms/): Official Google terms of service.
